archive_rule: pool allowed and restricted objective points, retain the non-dominated union, then retain every distinct configuration found at those coordinates

activation_definitions.first_solution_activation: at least one retained found configuration has NY/NJ share at or above the threshold
activation_definitions.front_wide_activation: every retained found configuration has NY/NJ share at or above the threshold

decomposition_identity: NY/NJ contribution + West Coast contribution + other contribution = allowed minus restricted quantity-weighted mean time
decomposition_limit: shipment-matched change relative to each shipment's restricted mean; it is not unique tracking of every split freight unit
scope_limit: Only the four targeted delay comparisons are closed by the new rerun. No claim is made that every cell in the historical capacity-delay map has a restricted-archive closure.
historical_compound_correction: The existing Chicago 30%-capacity + 168 h closed archive contains zero-share points and is carried as a transition correction. It is not relabelled as a new configuration-complete rerun.
